turns.patient_response: When I look in the mirror, even though my family says I'm too thin, I still see a little pouch on my stomach that I feel I need to lose. My weight completely dictates how I feel about myself—if the scale goes up even half a pound, I feel like a weak failure who isn't ready for this next stage of my life.
